entities.summary: Yabroud or Yabrud is a city in Syria, located in the Rif Dimashq governorate about 80 kilometres (50 mi) north of the capital Damascus. According to the Syria Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS), Yabroud had a population of 25,891 in the 2004 census.
